title: fix(image): fall GPT Image back on every Azure-side failure
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: GPT Image now tries the other Azure region, then OpenAI direct, when an Azure route fails with authentication, resource-block, timeout, or server errors; 429 and 404 already followed that route. Invalid caller requests, including content-policy refusals and dead reference images, still fail without trying another route. The change replaces a GPT Image-specific fallback rule with the shared isRetryableFallbackError rule. Customers are billed once at the Azure quote even when OpenAI serves the image, though a late Azure failure could result in up to three provider-side generations.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workstation, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small-to-medium in the scene and wearing a tiny tool belt, she guides one picture card along a path between two Azure-marked flower pots and an OpenAI-marked terminal, while a code-plant grows beside them. Strictly pixel art, never realistic: cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, warm cream background, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
